structure: Each person has a bivariate Gaussian stable component and two independent bivariate Gaussian visit-deviation vectors, independent of the stable component. Measurements are their sums. Persons are sampled independently. The unreported contemporaneous deviation correlation is assigned a common scenario value of 0.3 at both visits.

parameter_provenance.basis: Measurement means are zero and visit deviations have zero means, so stable-component means are zero.
Pearson correlation between stable X and Y components.
Unreported relationship chosen for a point scenario; applied equally at both visits.
The stable-component vector and visit-deviation vectors are independent under the stipulated measurement model.
Convenient sampling shape; not needed to identify the cross-visit second-moment functional.
Independent stable and deviation contributions give 4 + 1 = 5 at either visit.

requested_estimands.name: change_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Stable components cancel in changes. Each change has variance 2. With deviation covariances c1 and c2, the change covariance is c1+c2 and the correlation is (c1+c2)/2. The scenario sets c1=c2=0.3; neither covariance is reported.

requested_estimands.name: same_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: At visit t, the correlation is (3.2+c_t)/5. Choosing deviation covariance c_t=0.3 gives 0.7 at both visits. The records do not determine c_t.

requested_estimands.name: cross_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Independent visit deviations and independence from stable components leave Cov(X_visit1,Y_visit2)=3.2. Both measurement variances are 5, so the Pearson correlation is 3.2/5=0.64, regardless of the chosen contemporaneous deviation correlation or Gaussian shape.

limitations: These are artificial population constraints, not biomedical validation or evidence about a clinical population.
Contemporaneous cross-biomarker deviation dependence is unreported. The change and same-visit correlations are scenario values, not identified findings.
Equal contemporaneous deviation correlations across visits and Gaussian sampling shapes are additional assumptions.
The stipulated measurement variance is 5 despite the standardized-unit label; no unit-variance rescaling is applied.
Finite random samples will fluctuate around the population moments; the generator does not adjust realized moments.
checks_actually_performed: Analytically checked positive definiteness: stable covariance eigenvalues are 0.8 and 7.2; scenario deviation covariance eigenvalues are 0.7 and 1.3.
Analytically checked scenario change covariance 0.6, change variances 2, same-visit covariance 3.5, and cross-visit covariance 3.2.
Inspected the source for the required column order, integer person identifiers, independent person sampling, seed use, and absence of sample-moment adjustment.
No Python execution or empirical simulation checks were performed.
